authorization.purpose: Gate 1 one-shot strict-track frozen test scoring (NC entry-gate roadmap Task 2)
authorization.note: Unlocks scoring of the frozen 20% homology-cluster test partition exactly once; the scored output is audited and never used to adjust the frozen candidate release. Re-issue history: cbc3824 (evidence-config fix) -> d181f3d (run-manifest audit covers the frozen-test track) -> 0cace6b (docs-only OSF preregistration guide) -> 476faa9 (docs-only manuscript LaTeX). Scoring code, model, features, and data unchanged in every re-issue. Prior runs reproduced the scores byte-identically (run-2 SHA256 recorded in the output directory); the d181f3d and 0cace6b runs completed scoring and were stopped only at administrative artifact writes, whose anti-overwrite guards correctly refused to replace non-identical manifests/checkpoints (run-2 files preserved under versioned names).
